details: Package name '@bcryptln/becryptjs' is orthographically close to the widely-used 'bcryptjs' library (character transposition/insertion plus a similarly-named scope). No malicious behavior was identified in the package contents: no lifecycle hooks fetching or executing remote code, no credential or environment scraping, no hardcoded exfiltration endpoints, no obfuscated payloads. The name-similarity signal alone is subjective and may reflect a beginner mistake, a fork, or a genuinely unrelated package rather than a deliberate typosquat. Route to human review to confirm intent and package identity before making a public determination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
